question: What role does thiophene play in improving power conversion efficiency in Sb-based solar cells?
answer: Thiophene enhances power conversion efficiency in Sb-based solar cells by significantly impacting hole transfer properties in the hole transport material. Its inclusion in the hole transport material leads to improved charge extraction and a higher power conversion efficiency of 2.91%, independent of the HOMO level.

### 1. Summary of the Purpose of the Paper:
The paper aims to evaluate and optimize bismuth- and antimony-based materials as lead-free alternatives to lead halide perovskites for solar cell applications. It does so by systematically studying the energy levels, optoelectronic properties, and charge transfer characteristics of 44 material compositions across six crystal categories using time-resolved microwave conductivity (TRMC). The study identifies key factors, such as the inclusion of a thiophene component, that enhance power conversion efficiency and provides guidelines for material selection and device design to advance lead-free solar cell technologies.
